views.name: city_product_quarter_sales
views.body_sql:
SELECT 
    c.cust_city AS city,
    p.prod_name AS product,
    t.fiscal_quarter_desc AS quarter,
    SUM(s.amount_sold) AS non_promotional_sales
FROM sales s
JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
WHERE s.promo_id IS NULL
GROUP BY c.cust_city, p.prod_name, t.fiscal_quarter_desc
views.description: Aggregates non-promotional sales amounts grouped by city, product, and fiscal quarter.
